iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. OpenFA Braccatian HeartsBlood BR2C large transporter, required retrospective concept iteration1 of max3. Attached is actual paletted legacy, authoritative multi-angle reference. Preserve stout ochre/gold main barrel hull, rounded rose-copper narrower end cap with small central metal tip, opposite broad grey/dark aft cluster and FOUR separate rose-copper longitudinal side pods spaced at90 degrees around the central hull. Each side pod has repeated gold collar bands, integrated mounting brackets and dark end fittings; keep their count and the original broad clustered silhouette, not cargo containers. The aft central body has four recessed round dark openings with silver collars, rendered as openings without inventing engine/weapon function. Grey longitudinal cheek panels are subordinate to the four banded rose pods. Related family palette to WidowMaker: worn ochre brass, rose copper, slate grey and silver. Modest recess grime, scratches, isolated dents and sparse service seams; preserve broad color areas, no dense tiled panel grid. No flames, glass cockpit, new weapons, giant antennas or extra pods. Show one coherent three-quarter view and small axial/reverse view of exactly the same geometry, neutral charcoal studio background, no text or legacy pixel collage.
iterations.verdict: Rejected inset topology: the bottom outboard pod incorrectly has an open cup instead of the closed cap shared by its siblings; hero broad form/color retained provisionally.
